summary: Read the height h and the width w of a rectangular cake, plus a list of horizontal cut distances and a list of vertical cut distances. A horizontal distance is measured down from the top edge, and a vertical distance is measured in from the left edge. After every listed cut is applied, find the piece with the greatest area and write that area modulo 10^9 plus 7. Both h and w lie between 2 and 10^9. Each cut list has at least one entry and is shorter than the smaller of the matching side and 100000. Cut positions are distinct and fall strictly inside the cake.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
